Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Ache
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ache"** means a continuous or prolonged dull pain in a part of one's body. (दर्द)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt a dull **ache** in her lower back after working all day.
 
 
 
• **"Ease"** refers to the absence of difficulty or effort; it can also mean the alleviation of pain or discomfort. (आराम)
 
 
• **Example: **The medication helped** ease** the pain in his joints.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Ache' **is **'Ease'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Colic **(उदरशूल): Severe, often fluctuating pain in the abdomen caused by intestinal gas or obstruction in the intestines.

 
 
• **Example:** The baby was crying due to** colic **pains.
 
 
 
• **Serene **(शांत): Calm, peaceful, and untroubled.
 
 
• **Example: **The** serene** landscape was a perfect place to relax.
 
 
 
• **Gloomy** (उदास): Dark or poorly lit, especially so as to appear depressing or frightening.
 
 
• **Example:** The** gloomy** weather matched his mood perfectly.
